description.to:
Outcome: The brand pack format and validator are PPY-88a883; this task stores and serves them. A BrandPack is a SiteDocument (kind brand). On save, after validation, Papyrus writes one immutable stylesheet of custom properties (sites/<tenant>/_papyrus/brand-<hash>.css, cached for a year) and the next projection references it; the core stylesheet stays one shared, versioned file per release. Fonts come from an allow-list of self-hosted families with known metrics (no third-party font requests from readers' browsers), so the text floors hold. The logo is a media object under the tenant prefix with renditions.

Touches (verified at origin/develop 23fabe1d): src/papyrus_content/projection/standard (head rendering of the brand stylesheet), the brand pack validator module (PPY-88a883), new font assets under src/papyrus_content/projection/standard/assets/fonts/, the site store (PPY-c020ce).

Acceptance (Gherkin feature file: features_backend/brand-pack-serving.feature):
Scenario: A brand change changes one small file, not the site's CSS
    Given "alpha" changes its brand colour
    When the brand pack is saved
    Then a new brand stylesheet is written, the core stylesheet is unchanged, and pages reference the new file after re-projection

Scenario: A font outside the allow-list cannot be saved
    When an admin picks a font that is not on the list
    Then the save is refused

Dependencies: blocked by PPY-c020ce. Blocks PPY-3aa10f, PPY-810f42, PPY-413576. (Also recorded as kbs dependencies.)
Implements or extends: PPY-88a883.

Testing: pytest; browser policy checks (PPY-a78dfd) against two brand packs.
Rollout: Releasable alone.
Risk and mitigation: Risk: a brand change needs every page re-rendered to pick up the new hash. Mitigation: pages reference a stable per-tenant path whose object is short-cached, or the change queues a re-render through the fair queue (PPY-994bd0); decided with a measurement.

Releasable on its own: yes.
DynamoDB index: none.
AppSync authorisation: unchanged.
Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR on branch docs/multi-tenant-architecture).
